subject: generate ligand frcmod and lib files

messages.author: Madhur Aggarwal
messages.body:
Hi all,
I have parm7 and rst7 files for my system (system contains protein+ligand+water+ions). Is there a way to extract .frcmod and .lib files for the ligand from rst7 and parm7 files?
Thanks in advance,
Madhur Aggarwal
IIIT Hyderabad

messages.author: Elvis Martis
messages.body:
Try using parmed to save lib file, saveoff command
